title: CrossApp Wallet Game
tagline: A cross-chain smart wallet that other developers can install the SDK of and interact with being used in a brand new game
description:
This project uses smart contract wallets, with embedded signers and injected EIP-1193 provider with the multi-injected wallet provider (EIP-6963) to allow developers create their own wallet that comes with social login baked in.
It comes packaged in an SDK that allows developers to distribute this wallet.
Created a new game that uses an SDK of one of this wallets.
how_its_made:
Its using SSS for the embedded signer part (using Shield https://github.com/openfort-xyz/shield/)
its using smart contract wallets compliant with eip 4337 to enable gasless transactions.
its using EIP-6963 to inject the eIP-1193 so that we can interact with the wallet through connectKit.
